statement: Requirements: Xoá 3 file dev preview.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Đổi gate `mn-collection.css` trong master-include.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Verify `snippets/collection-header.liquid` + `snippets/product-loop-collection.liquid` render OK khi include từ template mới (không đổi 2 file này).
subject: Requirements

statement: rule section: Steps
subject: Steps

statement: Requirements: Sort_master: 3 items fixed (Bán_chạy / Giá_giảm_dần / Giá_tăng_dần).
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: PHÂN LOẠI: 3 cột fixed header — DÒNG BÁNH, DỊP DÙNG, TRẠNG THÁI.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Items trong 2 cột đầu nạp qua settings (comma-separated).
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Cột TRẠNG THÁI 2 item fixed: #Có_sẵn (available:product=true), #Đặt_trước (tag configurable).
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: LÀM MỚI button dùng `.mn-btn.mn-btn--sm` — reset toàn bộ.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Ẩn toàn bộ khối Shop_filter nếu `collection.products.size == 0`.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Grid dùng `.mn-collection-products__grid.listProduct-filter` (khớp mn-collection.css sẵn có).
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Loop qua `collection.products` include `product-loop-collection`.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Empty state đúng 2 case: collection rỗng vs filter zero-hit.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Pagination bằng `paginate collection.products by settings.collection_pagination_limit`.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Nút XEM THÊM `.mn-btn.btn-loadmore` — sau click gọi `?view=data&page=N` append + tăng data-page.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Filter query: sort dùng URL param `sortby=(…)` (Haravan `/search` filter syntax); filter groups nối bằng `&&`, item trong cùng group nối bằng `||`.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Query base: `handle_coll = (collectionid:product=<id>)` cho normal, `(vendor:product contains <q>)` cho `/vendors/…`, `(product_type:product=<q>)` cho `/types/…`.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Merch section chỉ show khi settings `collection_merch_show == true` AND `collections[settings.collection_merch_handle]` có ≥1 product.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Merch grid dùng 3 product đầu qua `product-loop-collection`.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: CTA section chỉ show khi settings `collection_cta_show == true`.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: CTA body dùng `settings.collection_cta_text` (multiline OK).
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Cả 2 khối dùng CSS đã có trong `mn-collection.css` (`.mn-collection-merch`, `.mn-collection-cta`).
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Zero JS console error trên `/collections/all` và ít nhất 1 collection thật (nếu có).
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Verify 3 breakpoint theo mn-collection.css: ≥1400px (3 col, pad 144), 1200–1399 (3 col, pad 72), 641–1199 (2 col, pad 24), ≤640 (1 col).
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Verify legacy shell không còn ai reference `?view=dev`.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Cập nhật `INTAKE.md` phạm vi mới.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Đảm bảo `theme-qa-az` skill routing (theme QA) chạy sạch nếu invoke.
subject: Requirements

statement: Steps: Nếu không có URL preview, chỉ static check + read theme code lint.
subject: Steps

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] `/collections/all` load OK.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] Filter click DÒNG BÁNH → grid update.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] Filter click 2 nhóm → combined query đúng.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] Sort click → thứ tự đúng.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] LÀM MỚI → reset.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] XEM THÊM append → data-page tăng, ẩn khi hết.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] Merch section visual match Figma.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] CTA section visual match Figma.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] Responsive 3 breakpoint không vỡ layout.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] JS console không có error.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] `templates/collection.dev*` không tồn tại.
subject: Verification checklist

statement: Verification checklist: [ ] `?view=dev` request không crash (chỉ trả về default template render).
subject: Verification checklist
